title: Terrible
body: Does not properly import. Adding recipes manually is way too difficult. You cannot see what you are typing! Poor design.

title: Poor Customer service and app
body: I purchased the lifetime subscription as I thought this was a respectable company. I asked customer service for help with merging my accounts with both my iPhone and my IPad. I sent them the requested information and I’m now being ghosted. Also, every time I look at my settings page and arrow back, the app glitches and bumps me out of it. Be leery of the app. There’s others that are better I’m sure!

title: Disappointed
body: I honestly thought this would be an app that would help me get recipes I see but not surprisingly the minute I try to use it will only let me use it if I pay for premium. Really heartbreaking because I’m not the best at just seeing something and knowing how to make it. Thought this app would help I was wrong.

title: Love it!!
body: I honestly love this app!! It is super useful. Has everything to make cooking much more easy! You sharing your grocery list with someone, add recipes in for the week and have it meal plan for you and create your grocery list FOR YOU! As well as track your macros if that’s something you’re into!! Also can do more languages than just English which could be very useful for some people! :)

title: Finally using my saved recipes
body: I had so many recipes saved that I never actually cooked. RecipeVault helped me organize them so I can find them again when I need dinner ideas.

title: Test review
body: Amazing experience!! Must try

title: Finally organized my recipes
body: As a mom, I’m constantly saving recipes from TikTok, Instagram, and websites, but I could never find them again when it was actually time to make dinner. Recipe Vault keeps everything organized in one place and makes meal planning so much easier. I’ve already found myself using recipes I would have completely forgotten about. Definitely worth downloading if you’re tired of digging through screenshots and saved posts.

title: The recipe app i didn’t know I NEEDED
body: As someone who constantly saves TikTok recipes and then forgets where they are, this app has been a game changer. I can now easily import my recipes into this app and it saves them forever. Definitely one of those apps I wish I had found sooner.

title: Love this app!
body: RecipeVault has completely changed how I save recipes. Instead of having recipes scattered across TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest, and random screenshots, everything is finally in one place. My favorite feature is how easy it is to share a recipe directly into the app and have it automatically organized into a clean, step-by-step format. The macro calculations, meal planning, and grocery list features are huge time savers too. If you’re someone who is constantly finding recipes online and never remembers where you saved them, this app is a game changer. Highly recommend!

title: Such a game changer
body: I spend sooo much time saving recipes all across Instagram and tiktok and taking a million screenshots. This app genuinely makes it so simple and keeps everything in one place. You can directly import from social media so no reason why you’d lose a recipe. It also makes grocery lists and can help you meal prep for the week! Def recommend!

title: Review
body: Very convenient all-in-one tool. I could import recipes directly from websites and social media and then immediately place it on my weekly meal. I like how it cleanly organizes the day by meals. Easy to use and very intuitive. I highly recommend if you are busy mom!!!

title: So much easier than screenshots!
body: My camera roll was full of recipe screenshots. RecipeVault is much cleaner and actually helps me find the recipe again.

title: Finally, all my recipes in one place
body: I didn’t realize how many recipes I was saving until I started using RecipeVault. Now everything is organized in one place, easy to find, and I actually cook the recipes I save. Such a simple app, but it makes a huge difference!
